title: 199. The struggles of job hunting in our 20s

sentences.zh: 这是一档 iHeart 播客，保证由真人制作。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在努力以一种现实的方式优先考虑自己的健康，而让我保持动力的一个因素就是我的 WHOOP 手环。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常看重数据的人，这就是我喜欢 WHOOP 的原因，因为我可以清楚地看到为什么我的身体在不同日子里会有不同的感觉，为什么我跑步的状态不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我有时注意力不够集中。

sentences.zh: WHOOP 可以轻松追踪我的睡眠、身体压力、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有这些数据和模式，让我能够做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该努力。

sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com/psychology 即可获得一个月的免费 WHOOP 体验。

sentences.zh: 有些人会保留他们所有的旧演出门票。

sentences.zh: 它能带回音乐，带回记忆，甚至带回当时的气味。

sentences.en: Other people collect perfume bottles or coffee mugs or overseas banknotes, classic sweaters from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 还有人收集香水瓶、咖啡杯、外国纸币，或是 80 年代的经典毛衣。

sentences.en: Collection is deeply personal.
sentences.zh: 收藏是非常私人的事情。

sentences.en: It says who we are, but it also says where we've come from.
sentences.zh: 它不仅诉说着我们是谁，也诉说着我们从哪里来。

sentences.zh: 在全新的播客《Charmed with Sam Todd》中，

sentences.zh: Sam 探索了那些成为我们生命一部分的记忆、执念和细小的珍宝。

sentences.en: Charmed with Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识山姆·托德。

sentences.en: Stories want to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: Pandora 倾情呈现。

sentences.en: Listen to the podcast now on iHeart.
sentences.zh: 现在就在 iHeart 上收听该播客。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to the Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《二十岁心理学》，这是一档探讨我们在二十多岁时所经历的一些重大人生变化和转折的播客，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及这些变化对我们的心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本期播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老听众，无论你身处世界何地，很高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，当然，我们要继续剖析二十多岁的心理。

sentences.en: Let's be real for a second.
sentences.zh: 让我们面对现实吧。

sentences.en: The job market, the job hunt, the economic climate, all of the above have gotten so tough in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，就业市场、求职环境、经济形势，所有这些都变得非常严峻。

sentences.en: And if you're in your 20s, you're probably feeling the pressure and the impact of this more than any other age group.
sentences.zh: 如果你正处于二十多岁，你可能比任何其他年龄段的人都更能感受到这种压力和影响。

sentences.en: It is so much more difficult than it was for our parents' generation even a few decades ago to find a job that can pay our bills but is also fulfilling
sentences.zh: 与几十年前我们父母那一代人相比，现在想要找到一份既能支付账单又令人满意的工作，难度要大得多，

sentences.en: or to even find entry-level opportunities in our chosen industry, much less a stable career path.
sentences.zh: 甚至在自己选择的行业中找到入门级机会都很难，更不用说稳定的职业道路了。

sentences.en: And I think this experience of struggling with unemployment and continuous job hunting, the pressure to have it all figured out,
sentences.zh: 我认为这种在失业和持续求职中挣扎的经历，以及那种必须把一切都规划好的压力，

sentences.en: the pressure to have some fulfilling, rewarding job lined up, some fulfilling, rewarding career is really feeling increasingly impossible in this day and age.
sentences.zh: 那种必须拥有一份充实、有回报的工作，拥有一份充实、有回报的职业的压力，在当今时代正变得越来越难以实现。

sentences.en: So I wanted to talk about it and I wanted to help you understand the science behind not only why it's so difficult but why there is so much shame and frustration
sentences.zh: 所以我想要谈谈这个话题，并帮助你理解其背后的科学，不仅是为什么它如此困难，还有为什么在二十多岁求职时，会有那么多的羞耻感和挫败感，

sentences.en: and at times even anger and resentment when it comes to job hunting in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 甚至有时还会产生愤怒和怨恨。

sentences.en: I think that this topic definitely doesn't get enough of a spotlight and I'll admit I've even fallen into I think a bit of complacency myself.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个话题绝对没有得到足够的关注，我也承认，我自己也曾陷入过一点自满。

sentences.en: I have taken my own circumstances for granted because I was really lucky to kind of fall into something I loved quite early on.
sentences.zh: 我把自己的境遇视为理所当然，因为我很幸运，很早就找到了一份自己热爱的工作。

sentences.en: I don't think that is the case for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我不认为每个人都这么幸运。

sentences.en: I really think that a more universal experience is one of struggling to find your professional place in the world early on in your career.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为，更普遍的经历是在职业生涯早期努力寻找自己在世界上的专业定位。

sentences.en: And just recently I've had so many friends going through redundancies and periods of unemployment, constant rejections and it's emotionally challenging.
sentences.zh: 最近，我有很多朋友经历了裁员和失业期，不断被拒绝，这在情感上是非常具有挑战性的。

sentences.en: I can see them really struggling with it.
sentences.zh: 我能看出他们真的为此感到挣扎。

sentences.en: So much of our self-esteem and our self-concept is tied to what we do for work.
sentences.zh: 我们的自尊和自我概念很大程度上与我们的工作挂钩。

sentences.en: It is tied to how we make money.
sentences.zh: 它与我们如何赚钱挂钩。

sentences.en: It is tied to our sense of purpose.
sentences.zh: 它与我们的目标感挂钩。

sentences.en: So when that is taken away from us or it's unavailable no matter how hard we try, no matter how many job applications we put out, we feel firstly quite aimless
sentences.zh: 所以，当这一切被剥夺，或者无论我们多么努力、投递了多少份简历都无法获得时，我们首先会感到非常迷茫，

sentences.en: but secondly like we have somehow failed in a way that so many others have been successful.
sentences.zh: 其次会觉得自己在某种程度上失败了，而其他人却取得了成功。

sentences.en: We think there must be something wrong with us.
sentences.zh: 我们认为一定是自己出了什么问题。

sentences.en: We make assumptions about what other people are thinking about us, that we're lazy, that we lack discipline, that we aren't skilled.
sentences.zh: 我们对他人的想法做出假设，认为别人觉得我们懒惰、缺乏纪律、能力不足，

sentences.en: when there are so many other explanations for unemployment and struggling with job searching, struggling with your career during this decade.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，在这个十年里，失业和求职困难、职业生涯受挫还有许多其他原因。

sentences.en: So today we are going to talk about the psychological impact of job hunting, unemployment, setbacks and rejections in our 20s, how we can manage our emotional well-being
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们要谈谈二十多岁时求职、失业、挫折和拒绝带来的心理影响，以及我们如何管理自己的情绪健康，

sentences.en: whilst also staying focused and keeping optimistic about opportunities that come our way.
sentences.zh: 同时保持专注，对迎面而来的机会保持乐观。

sentences.en: We're also going to talk about concepts like bridging jobs, why there is no shame in doing something that you don't necessarily love for a paycheck,
sentences.zh: 我们还将讨论诸如“过渡性工作”之类的概念，为什么为了薪水去做一份你不一定热爱的工作并不丢人，

sentences.en: why it's okay to not have a five-year plan, the myth of the dream job and how to find your purpose during a very confusing period of life.
sentences.zh: 为什么没有五年计划也没关系，以及“梦想工作”的迷思，还有如何在人生这段非常困惑的时期找到自己的目标。

sentences.en: I strongly believe that when we talk openly about these situations, we reduce a lot of the invisible shame we're feeling that I think forces us to keep things to ourselves
sentences.zh: 我坚信，当我们公开谈论这些情况时，就能减少我们内心感到的那种无形的羞耻感，我认为正是这种羞耻感迫使我们将事情藏在心里，

sentences.en: when they would become so much easier and lighter out in the open.
sentences.zh: 而如果说出来，一切都会变得轻松许多。

sentences.en: Trust me, if you're going through this right now, I really cannot express how many people have reached out to me with similar situations,
sentences.zh: 相信我，如果你现在正经历这些，我真的无法表达有多少人向我倾诉过类似的情况，

sentences.en: how many friends of mine are going through this, some of them even in their late 20s, early 30s, and even broader than that, how every single trend
sentences.zh: 我身边有多少朋友正在经历这些，其中一些人甚至已经快三十岁或刚过三十岁，更广泛地说，每一个趋势

sentences.en: is pointing to this being more difficult for this generation, to this being harder.
sentences.zh: 都表明这一代人面临的情况更加困难，更加艰巨。

sentences.en: It is not just you, I promise.
sentences.zh: 我保证，这不仅仅是你一个人的问题。

sentences.en: So we're going to slow it down.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们要放慢节奏。

sentences.en: We're going to look at the psychology.
sentences.zh: 我们要深入探讨其中的心理学。

sentences.en: We're going to talk all about it and hopefully make you feel a little bit better about your situation.
sentences.zh: 我们要畅所欲言，希望这能让你对自己的处境感觉好一点。

sentences.en: So all of that and more after this short break.
sentences.zh: 所有这些以及更多内容，稍后回来继续讨论。

sentences.en: We talk about it a lot on this show, but there is definitely this unspoken pressure in our 20s to know what we are doing with our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中经常谈论这个话题，但在二十多岁时，确实有一种无形的压力，要求我们知道自己的人生要做什么。

sentences.en: There is an emphasis on having a five-year plan, on having a dream job, financial independence, job security.
sentences.zh: 人们强调要有五年计划，要有梦想工作，要实现财务独立和职业保障。

sentences.en: That can feel really suffocating if that just hasn't been your path so far, or perhaps you just don't want it to be.
sentences.zh: 如果这并不是你迄今为止的道路，或者你根本不想走这条路，那会让人感到非常窒息。

sentences.en: I think I will continue to repeat this for as long as I can, but this decade, our 20s, is a period of flux and that is both a blessing and a curse.
sentences.zh: 我想我会尽可能反复强调这一点，但二十多岁这个十年是一个变动的时期，这既是福也是祸。

sentences.en: It is this time in our life where there is so much available to us, but all of our timelines, the timelines of yourself and everybody around you is splintering.
sentences.zh: 这是我们生命中拥有无限可能的时期，但我们所有人的时间表，你自己的以及周围所有人的时间表，都在分崩离析。

sentences.en: For the first like 18, 19 years of our lives, we were in school.
sentences.zh: 在我们生命的前 18、19 年里，我们都在学校里。

sentences.en: We are typically doing the same things in the same environment.
sentences.zh: 我们通常在相同的环境中做着相同的事情。

sentences.en: With the same ultimate goal as everybody around us, which is to graduate before we kind of get stuck into the real world.
sentences.zh: 怀着和周围所有人一样的最终目标，那就是在进入现实世界之前先毕业。

sentences.en: It is very structured.
sentences.zh: 这非常有条理。

sentences.en: It is very uniform, very repetitive for each and all of us.
sentences.zh: 对我们每个人来说，这都非常统一且重复。

sentences.en: When we walk across the stage, when we graduate, suddenly after 18 years of always having somebody tell us what is next, what the requirements of moving forward are,
sentences.zh: 当我们走上舞台毕业时，突然间，在 18 年来一直有人告诉我们下一步该做什么、前进的要求是什么之后，

sentences.en: we have agency and choice and freedom to choose where we want to go, who we want to be and the goalposts kind of disappear.
sentences.zh: 我们有了自主权、选择权和自由，可以去选择自己想去的地方、想成为的人，而目标似乎消失了。

sentences.en: Maybe you do end up going to university and the goalposts are kind of reinstated, but only for another three, four, maybe five years.
sentences.zh: 也许你最终会去上大学，目标似乎又恢复了，但那也只是为了接下来的三、四年，或许五年。

sentences.en: At some point, school is going to kind of spit you out into the world and you have to kind of figure out a way of operating in this new environment, one that, you know,
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，学校会把你推向社会，你必须想办法在这个新环境中生存，而你知道，

sentences.en: I do think the education system doesn't really get us prepared for.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为教育系统并没有真正让我们为此做好准备。

sentences.en: You know, it's not just about grades and assignments anymore.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不再仅仅是关于成绩和作业了。

sentences.en: You have to put into practice everything that you've learned and there will definitely be a learning curve and it's only natural to be struggling with that.
sentences.zh: 你必须将所学的一切付诸实践，这肯定会有一个学习曲线，为此感到挣扎是很自然的。

sentences.en: This whole period in the field of psychology is known as emerging adulthood and the word emerging there is really important because I think it highlights
sentences.zh: 在心理学领域，整个这一时期被称为“成年初期”，其中“初期”这个词非常重要，因为我认为它强调了

sentences.en: how transitionary this period is.
sentences.zh: 这个时期是多么具有过渡性。

sentences.en: It is not the final chapter.
sentences.zh: 这不是人生的最后一章。

sentences.en: It is the first chapter in a very long life, in a very long career, hopefully.
sentences.zh: 希望这只是漫长一生、漫长职业生涯的第一章。

sentences.en: I think that there is not one thing about our career during this decade that is permanent.
sentences.zh: 我认为在这个十年里，我们的职业生涯中没有什么是永久的。

sentences.en: Those, the jobs that you're applying for, for example, they could not exist in like 20 years.
sentences.zh: 例如，你正在申请的那些工作，20 年后可能都不存在了。

sentences.en: The unpaid internships, eventually you won't have to do them anymore.
sentences.zh: 那些无薪实习，最终你将不再需要去做它们。

sentences.en: The terrible bosses, one day you will quit that job and you will find something more meaningful and purposeful.
sentences.zh: 那些糟糕的老板，总有一天你会辞职，找到更有意义、更有目标的工作。

sentences.en: The job interviews, the confusion, eventually that will go away.
sentences.zh: 那些面试、困惑，最终都会消失。

sentences.en: Eventually it will become more clear to you what you want to do, where you want to be, who you want to be.
sentences.zh: 最终，你会更清楚自己想做什么，想去哪里，想成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: But all of those things that we really struggle with, they are to be expected.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些我们真正挣扎的事情，都是意料之中的。

sentences.en: When we're kind of first starting out, I think the misconception that makes us feel really terrible is that this will be like this forever, right?
sentences.zh: 当我们刚开始起步时，我认为那种让我们感觉非常糟糕的误解是：一切将永远如此，对吧？

sentences.en: We are always going to feel this loSt.
sentences.zh: 我们会一直感到如此迷茫。

sentences.en: We are always going to feel this aimless, this purposeless.
sentences.zh: 我们会一直感到如此漫无目的，如此没有目标。

sentences.en: We're always going to be in this state of striving for an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我们会一直处于这种为机会而奋斗的状态。

sentences.en: But secondly to that, that it is an us problem, not a societal one.
sentences.zh: 其次，这被认为是我们的个人问题，而不是社会问题。

sentences.en: So when I was researching this episode, I came across two articles that were super enlightening when it came to this exact point.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我在研究这一期节目时，我发现了两篇非常有启发性的文章，正好谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: Job hunting and a lack of success that many of us are experiencing is a societal problem rather than an individual one.
sentences.zh: 求职困难以及我们许多人正在经历的挫折，是一个社会问题，而不是个人问题。

sentences.en: So the first article was published by the BBC last year and it essentially said nearly all young workers, so people between
sentences.zh: 第一篇文章是去年由 BBC 发表的，它基本上说，几乎所有的年轻劳动者，也就是 18 到 30 岁之间的人，

sentences.en: 18 and 30, are struggling to cope with economic uncertainty but also the instability of the job market.
sentences.zh: 都在努力应对经济不确定性，以及就业市场的不稳定性。

sentences.en: And what this article said was that about
sentences.zh: 这篇文章指出，大约

sentences.en: 91% of us are experiencing or have experienced at least one instant of stress around our future career and our future job insecurity or security in the last six months.
sentences.zh: 91% 的人在过去六个月里经历过或正在经历至少一次关于未来职业、未来工作不安全感或安全感的压力。

sentences.en: 91% of us in our 20s essentially are feeling very much unstable and unsure of what is next.
sentences.zh: 我们二十多岁的人中，有 91% 的人基本上都感到非常不稳定，对未来感到不确定。

sentences.en: A lot of this also came down to three large-scale stresses.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上归结为三个大规模的压力源。

sentences.en: A, fewer entry-level jobs, that is a proven fact, there are less opportunities for people who are junior or just starting out to get their foot in the door.
sentences.zh: A，入门级工作减少，这是一个被证实的事实，对于初级或刚起步的人来说，获得机会的门槛更高了。

sentences.en: B, increasing competition for a smaller pool of opportunities.
sentences.zh: B，在较少的工作机会中竞争日益激烈。

sentences.en: It's not just that there are more people who want a smaller amount of jobs but that those people are more educated, more proficient, have done more internships, have more
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是更多的人想要更少的工作，而是这些人受教育程度更高、更精通业务、实习经历更多、拥有比以往任何时候都多的

sentences.en: job experience than ever before and C, there is this rising cost of living which means that even if you do get one of those coveted entry-level jobs, even if you do
sentences.zh: 工作经验，而且 C，生活成本不断上升，这意味着即使你真的得到了那些令人垂涎的入门级工作，即使你真的

sentences.en: surpass all those dozens, hundreds of others, you still might not be able to pay your bills.
sentences.zh: 超越了那几十、几百个竞争者，你可能仍然无法支付账单。

sentences.en: That is one component of why this is so increasingly stressful.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这变得越来越令人压抑的一个组成部分。

sentences.en: The second article was from
sentences.zh: 第二篇文章来自

sentences.en: Time magazine and it was titled
sentences.zh: 《时代》杂志，标题是

sentences.en: You're Not
sentences.zh: “你不是

sentences.en: Imagining It,
sentences.zh: 在胡思乱想，

sentences.en: Job Hunting Is Getting
sentences.zh: 求职确实变得

sentences.en: Worse.
sentences.zh: 越来越难了”。

sentences.en: I'm going to leave a link to this article in the description because if this describes your experience you need to read this article and what they explain is that the tightening
